questions.stem: A 29 years old male patient presented with dizziness, ataxia, nausea, and vomiting, the offending drug was stopped. He became symptom-free after 48 hours. Identify the drug.
questions.solutionHtml:
Minocycline

Minocycline is an antibiotic medicine used to treat bacterial infections in your body. It is effective in some infections of the lungs, urinary tract, eyes and others. It kills bacteria, which helps to improve your symptoms and cure the infection.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:787

questions.stem: A patient aged around 25 presents with complaints of foul-smelling white discharge from the urethra. He also had discharge from the urethra. He also had burning micturition for 10 days. He also gave a history of intercourse with a commercial sex worker 7 days prior to the onset of all symptoms. Gram staining showed gram-negative diplococci. Which of the following drug is the drug of choice for this condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Ceftriaxone

Ceftriaxone is an antibiotic medicine used to treat bacterial infections in your body. It is effective in infections of the brain, lungs, ear, urinary tract, skin and soft tissues, bones and joints, blood and heart. It is also used to prevent infections during surgery.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 804

questions.stem: A 23-year-old female presented with burning pain during micturition. On investigations, she is found to be suffering from co-infection with chlamydia and gonococcus. The drug of choice for the treatment of this female is: -
questions.solutionHtml:
Azithromycin

Azithromycin is an antibiotic used to treat various types of infections of the respiratory tract, ear, skin and eye in adults and children. It is also effective in typhoid fever and some sexually transmitted diseases like gonorrhoea



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 804

questions.stem: A 56-year-old male prescribed an infected insect bite above his right knee. A large, tender, fluctuant right inguinal lymph node was identified along with several adjacent lymph nodes that were mildly enlarged. Serology for tularemia was found to be reactive. Which of the following drug do you use in this condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Streptomycin

Streptomycin is an antibiotic used in the treatment of tuberculosis, in combination with other medicines. It works by stopping the growth of tubercular bacteria. Rarely, it may also be used to treat some other types of infections.



Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page No. 1043

questions.stem: A young female presented to the hospital OPD with a suspected chlamydial infection. She was prescribed oral doxycycline for 2 weeks. options.label: C

options.label: D

questions.answerText: Treat her with a single oral dose of azithromycin

Treat her with a single oral dose of azithromycin
